sourceNotes: 更新为 Wi-Fi 信号弧线与 XStats 监控曲线组合图标，统一近白底板、视觉大小与留白（#20）
支持标准与手绘图标切换，保留选择并同步程序坞、访达和聚焦搜索中的应用图标
修正 DNS 查询名称与解析器地址的错误关联，统一域名格式并过滤反向查询名称

en: Combine Wi-Fi signal arcs with the XStats monitoring curve, using a consistent near-white tile, visual size and spacing (#20)
Switch between standard and hand-drawn icons, remember the selection and synchronize the application icon across the Dock, Finder and Spotlight
Prevent DNS query names from being associated with resolver addresses, normalize domain names and filter reverse lookup names
